summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the Universal API Intelligence Diagnostics & Verification System. All backend tests passed (19/19 pytest). All frontend UI elements verified. The feature correctly implements instance-wide diagnostics summary, passive documentation scan, AI discovery test, execution test with schema validation, unified reasoning test, and diagnostic history.
critical_code_review_comments: Instance summary endpoint correctly returns KB sources count, integrations, endpoints, doc coverage, LLM provider, and last unified test
Passive scan is FREE (no API/LLM calls) and returns comprehensive coverage metrics: response schema, field descriptions, parameters, endpoint descriptions, response examples, error docs
AI Discovery test uses real LLM routing (API_ROUTE_PROMPT + call_claude) and returns selected endpoints with permissions validation
Execution test executes real endpoints and validates response against stored schema with field-level detail
Unified test runs FULL pipeline: KB retrieval → endpoint discovery → LLM selection → permission validation → API execution → schema retrieval → context assembly → answer generation
History endpoint returns past diagnostic runs with type, status, duration, timestamp, and details
Bot instance isolation correctly enforced - diagnostics only access endpoints belonging to the requesting instance
Frontend shows Instance Intelligence Summary bar with all stats (KB Sources, Integrations, Endpoints, Doc Coverage, LLM Provider, Last Unified Test)
Each integration card has Diagnostics button that opens the diagnostics panel
Diagnostics panel shows all 5 sections with correct cost tags (FREE, LLM TOKENS, API CALL, LLM + API)
Run Scan button executes passive scan and displays coverage bars with percentages
seed_data_creation: No test data created - used existing Grid Scan integration with 90 endpoints
context_for_next_testing_agent: API Intelligence Diagnostics feature fully tested. Backend endpoints: GET /api/diagnostics/instance-summary, GET /api/integrations/{id}/diagnostics/scan, POST /api/integrations/{id}/diagnostics/discovery, POST /api/integrations/{id}/diagnostics/execution, POST /api/integrations/{id}/diagnostics/unified, GET /api/integrations/{id}/diagnostics/history. Frontend: ApiDiagnostics.js component with 5 collapsible sections, InstanceDiagnosticsSummary component in ApiIntegrations.js. The Grid Scan integration has 90 endpoints (89 enabled) for testing.
